info.title: McpProbe.Cli
info.description: mcpprobe: a CLI that connects to any MCP server over stdio or HTTP and checks its tool surface against a committed snapshot (breaking-change detection) and lint rules. Built for CI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Check an MCP server's tool surface: snapshot it, diff it against a committed snapshot, and lint it.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Connect to a server and write its tool surface to a snapshot file.

options.name: --stdio
options.description: Start the server with this command line and talk to it over stdio, for example "dotnet run --project src/MyServer".

options.name: --http
options.description: Connect to a server over HTTP (Streamable HTTP, falling back to legacy SSE), for example http://localhost:5000/mcp.

options.name: --transport
options.description: HTTP transport to use: auto (try Streamable HTTP, then fall back to legacy SSE), streamable-http, or sse (the legacy SSE transport, not the event stream inside Streamable HTTP). Only with --http. [default: auto]

options.name: --header
options.description: HTTP header as 'Name: value'. Repeatable. Only with --http.

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment variable for the stdio server as NAME=value. Repeatable. Only with --stdio.

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Working directory for the stdio server.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for the server to start and list its tools. [default: 60]

options.name: --out
options.description: Where to write the snapshot. [default: mcp-tools.json]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare a server's tool surface with a snapshot. Exits 1 on breaking changes.

options.name: --stdio
options.description: Start the server with this command line and talk to it over stdio, for example "dotnet run --project src/MyServer".

options.name: --http
options.description: Connect to a server over HTTP (Streamable HTTP, falling back to legacy SSE), for example http://localhost:5000/mcp.

options.name: --transport
options.description: HTTP transport to use: auto (try Streamable HTTP, then fall back to legacy SSE), streamable-http, or sse (the legacy SSE transport, not the event stream inside Streamable HTTP). Only with --http. [default: auto]

options.name: --header
options.description: HTTP header as 'Name: value'. Repeatable. Only with --http.

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment variable for the stdio server as NAME=value. Repeatable. Only with --stdio.

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Working directory for the stdio server.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for the server to start and list its tools. [default: 60]

options.name: --from-file
options.description: Read the current tool surface from a snapshot file instead of a server.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: The committed snapshot to compare against. [default: mcp-tools.json]

options.name: --fail-on-non-breaking
options.description: Also fail (exit 1) on non-breaking changes, so the snapshot is always kept up to date. [default: False]

options.name: --report
options.description: Also write a self-contained HTML report to this file. stdout and the exit code are unchanged.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint tool names, descriptions and parameters. Exits 1 on findings at or above --fail-on, or on a portability error when --strict is set.

options.name: --stdio
options.description: Start the server with this command line and talk to it over stdio, for example "dotnet run --project src/MyServer".

options.name: --http
options.description: Connect to a server over HTTP (Streamable HTTP, falling back to legacy SSE), for example http://localhost:5000/mcp.

options.name: --transport
options.description: HTTP transport to use: auto (try Streamable HTTP, then fall back to legacy SSE), streamable-http, or sse (the legacy SSE transport, not the event stream inside Streamable HTTP). Only with --http. [default: auto]

options.name: --header
options.description: HTTP header as 'Name: value'. Repeatable. Only with --http.

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment variable for the stdio server as NAME=value. Repeatable. Only with --stdio.

options.name: --cwd

options.name: --from-file
options.description: Read the current tool surface from a snapshot file instead of a server.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Lowest severity that makes the command exit 1: error, warning, info or none. [default: warning]

options.name: --min-description-length
options.description: Minimum tool description length for MCPP002. [default: 20]

options.name: --rule
options.description: Override a rule's severity, for example --rule MCPP007=none or --rule MCPP003=error. Repeatable.

options.name: --nested
options.description: Also check nested object properties and array items, not just top-level parameters. [default: False]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Also run schema-portability rules MCPP009-MCPP012. Those findings fail the command only when their severity is error. [default: False]

options.name: --report
options.description: Also write a self-contained HTML report to this file. stdout and the exit code are unchanged.
